label_freeze: Rules versioned before new-model outputs; analyst already knows the historical replay, so this is not a blind or externally adjudicated study.
not_ground_truth: No real users, real attacks or population prevalence. Labels express a declared protection rubric, not attack detection truth.

families.rationale: Known device, familiar time/network and at most a small typing-error counter; author-defined usability target.
A legitimate schedule/network change permits a challenge; outright rejection is a usability cost in this rubric.
Unproven device requires fresh MFA, independently of a numeric score.
Expired server trust requires reauthentication, not an automatic priority rejection.
Repeated failures plus an unfamiliar weekday/hour and nontrusted network warrant at least MFA under the analyst threat rubric; this is not a new production guard.
Multiple suspicious signals require additional protection. MFA and DENY are reported separately, not treated as equivalent access outcomes.
Shared-IP failures may belong to other users; unnecessary DENY is a usability cost, not a measured real-world false positive.
Insufficient history has no valid numeric estimate; require MFA.
Counter I/O failure is INCOMPLETE, not an observed zero count.
Missing network intelligence is INCOMPLETE.
History lookup failure is INCOMPLETE.
Security-revoked device must be denied, even when other data is missing.
Explicit blocked-IP rule precedes extraction and scoring.
Pending MFA reset is a priority denial; it is not a score-based HIGH.
Older events must be excluded and the selected history capped; evaluate a legitimate profile under that observation window.
Hidden actor intent cannot be recovered from identical observable context; excluded from primary agreement, retained to show the identifiability limit.
A fixed-window counter may expire; this family is a clock simulation of declared Lua semantics, not a Redis integration test.
Familiar context with adequate observations allows; the variant below minimum-events instead requires MFA.
Variant labels follow the 30-day trust boundary or an explicit security revocation, not the model score.
Trusted/default/elevated/high policy sources are distinguished; high network must at least challenge.
Mechanical neighborhood probes have no independent quality label; check numeric contracts against an exact oracle only.

service_unavailable: Outside a successful Risk evaluation: reuse existing SPI failureMode DENY tests/source evidence, do not manufacture Risk HIGH rows or claim new Browser acceptance.
